_comment: What the launch film's poster JPEG and the film itself DISPLAY, written down so a
gate can check it. The artwork is a bitmap: nothing on the page, in the markup or in
the API says what its figures are, so it rots silently and no check can see it.
Read off the rendered poster on 2026-10-13. The card reads 'THE GAP', 'NASDAQ . NVDA',
'$226.32 MARKET PRICE', '$93.96 THIS MODEL, UNLEVERED FREE CASH FLOW', '-58.5% MODEL
VS MARKET', and 'Prices as of 12 Oct 2026'.
scripts/check_launch_artwork.py compares every figure here against the live model and
fails when they disagree. It cannot check the BITMAP, so this file is the claim, and the
bitmap has to be regenerated to match it.
To REFRESH: rebuild the artwork with the figures below, update this file to match, and
the gate goes green. Do not update this file alone -- that makes the gate agree with a
poster that still says something else, which is the failure this exists to catch.
